details: The brush 'brush' event (line 254) fires on every mousemove and synchronously executes a full canvas redraw of all 500 earthquakes (`renderGlobe`), a KDE recomputation across all zones (`updateRidgeline`), and a full SVG attribute update (`updateScatter`) with no debouncing, throttling, or RAF coalescing — a severe update storm. Additionally, `updateRidgeline` starts a 200ms transition (lines 386-398) without calling `.interrupt()` first, so rapid brushing queues conflicting mid-flight transitions on the ridgeline paths.
